dissertation.title: Evaluating Agentic AI in Business Analysis: Intent Routing Accuracy and Error Explainability

architecture_1.name: Pure Routing Pattern
architecture_1.key_limitation: Cannot handle vague or multi-intent queries

architecture_3.name: Reflection Pattern
architecture_3.key_improvement: Correctly flagged UNCERTAIN on ALL misrouted queries
architecture_3.key_limitation: Does not improve routing accuracy over Architecture 2

key_findings: Multi-intent queries remain unsolved at 50.0% across all architectures
Architecture 3 correctly flagged uncertainty on ALL misrouted queries
Architecture 3 is most trustworthy — honest about its own limitations
Keyword-based routing has fundamental ceiling on multi-intent queries

research_questions_answered.RQ1: Three agentic architectures designed using Routing, Orchestrator-Workers, and Reflection patterns
research_questions_answered.RQ2: Overall accuracy 83.3-90.0%, degrades on ambiguous (66.7-100%) and multi-intent (50%) queries
research_questions_answered.RQ3: Architecture 3 produces factual and contrastive explanations — correctly flags uncertainty on misrouted cases, demonstrating honest self-awareness over plausible but incorrect confidence
